items.name: Vårarve
items.observations: Original pedagogical watercolor illustration of spring whitlowgrass with a compact, lightly hairy basal rosette, several slender leafless flowering stalks, tiny white lobed flowers, green oblong flattened seed capsules and fine roots. Viewed against pure black after alpha cleanup. The species naturally has four deeply bifid petals; tiny flower-petal details are stylized.
items.limitations: Stylized botanical illustration, not field-verified specimen, photograph or definitive morphological identification key. Flower petal notches, fine branching hairs and the number/size of individual flowers are simplified.
